directories.description: Explicit absolute locations for independently owned archives.

collector.description: Selected server Collector source; desktop-only configurations do not start a Collector.

batchServices.description: Third-party batch service configuration used by scheduler and importers

IDataDirectories.description: Independently located archives; only reference storage may be shared with a server.

feed.description: Provider connection entitlement; execution consumers use source timestamps unchanged.

IConfigCollector.description: One source is selected for server live, recovery and finalized-day maintenance.

id.description: Filesystem-safe identity; changing it starts a separate environment.

currency.description: Account base currency; casing is normalized after schema validation.

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether this account may deliver notifications through globally configured channels; absence means disabled

soundsEnabled.description: Whether the Live client may play position lifecycle sounds for this account; absence means disabled

instrumentPoolIds.description: Instrument pool ids that the account can use. If undefined, the account can use all instruments available in the context.

strategySlugs.description: Strategy slugs that the account can use. If undefined, the account can use all configured strategy slugs. Slugs are composed as `<series>.<branch>`.

defaultRiskProfileId.description: Generic risk profile selected when the strategy type has no configured preferred profile.

maxLossPerDay.description: Optional account-specific replacement for trader.defaultMaxLossPerDay. Fixed values use account currency; percentage values use risk-day opening equity adjusted for nontrading cash flows. Historical and Live execution block subsequent entries after an observed breach without liquidating positions or canceling accepted orders. A strategy risk override cannot change this account-wide limit.

riskOverrides.description: Final field-level overrides applied to every Live strategy after static strategy configuration.

collectionMode.description: Universal collection mode used to decide how tax cash is paid

initialMarginPerContract.description: Initial margin requirement per contract side; fixed values are account-currency amounts and `perc` values are ratios of local contract notional.

maintenanceMarginPerContract.description: Maintenance margin requirement per contract side; fixed values are account-currency amounts and `perc` values are ratios of local contract notional.

exchangeCommission.description: Commission applied when converting from source currency to account currency

commissionPerOrder.description: Commission per order side (charged twice for round-trip)

allowMarketOrdersInExtendedHours.description: Allow market orders in extended hours sessions

allowShorting.description: Whether newly created simulated accounts may open short exposure.

ISimBrokerProviderConfig.description: Follow source timestamps continuously; instruments are admitted when requested.

id.description: Human-readable identity retained with the complete resolved policy.

randomness.description: Probability that an ordinary order receives one injected execution scenario, not its severity.

seed.description: Stable experiment seed; account and economic order coordinates isolate deterministic draws.

ISimBrokerServiceProfile.description: Standalone policy: full bar-volume capacity is engine-owned; quote-based spread is unavailable.

value.description: Non-negative magnitude. With type "perc", this is a ratio from 0 to 1 resolved against the basis documented by the owning parameter; otherwise it uses that parameter's fixed unit.

type.description: Value interpretation: "fixed" uses the owning parameter's unit and "perc" uses its documented basis. Defaults to "fixed".

ILiveRiskOverrides.description: Account-owned final overrides exposed by the Live risk editor.

additionalProperties.description: Use symbol, instrument type or currency as key (E.g. AAPL, future, USD). Use `*` for default values

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether this account may deliver notifications through globally configured channels; absence means disabled

soundsEnabled.description: Whether the Live client may play position lifecycle sounds for this account; absence means disabled

strategySlugs.description: Strategy slugs that the account can use. If undefined, the account can use all configured strategy slugs. Slugs are composed as `<series>.<branch>`.

Fixed values use account currency; percentage values use risk-day opening equity adjusted for nontrading cash flows. Historical and Live execution block subsequent entries after an observed breach without liquidating positions or canceling accepted orders. maintenanceMarginPerContract.description: Maintenance margin requirement per contract side; fixed values are account-currency amounts and `perc` values are ratios of local contract notional.

exchangeCommission.description: Commission applied when converting from source currency to account currency

commissionPerOrder.description: Commission per order side (charged twice for round-trip)

allowMarketOrdersInExtendedHours.description: Allow market orders in extended hours sessions

allowShorting.description: Whether newly created simulated accounts may open short exposure.

startDate.description: Source UTC dates, inclusive. Provider timestamps remain unchanged.

playbackIntervalMs.description: Wall-clock pacing of historical minutes, unrelated to provider delay.

ISimBrokerHistoricalConfig.description: Historical replay alone owns an explicit period, universe and wall-clock pacing.

strategies.description: Strategy slugs selected by the caller; frozen runtime configurations contain resolved concrete keys.

instrumentUniverse.description: Instrument universe requested by the trader config

riskProfiles.description: Complete reusable entry-risk profiles selectable by accounts. The selected profile supplies the base values before optional strategyRiskOverrides entries.

strategyRiskOverrides.description: Optional risk overrides keyed by canonical strategy type. Each entry may prefer a generic risk profile and replace individual fields after generic profile selection.

targetExitTolerancePerc.description: Maximum adverse retracement from a touched target at the completed-minute close. Expressed as a ratio of the raw target price: 0.002 means 0.2%. This controls Market submission, not the eventual fill price. Zero requires a close at or beyond target.

strategyTargetExitOverrides.description: Optional target tolerance replacements keyed by the exact versioned strategy id.

defaultMaxLossPerDay.description: Default hard account loss limit used when an account does not override it. Fixed values use account currency; percentage values use risk-day opening equity adjusted for nontrading cash flows. The observed limit blocks later entries in historical and Live execution without liquidation or cancellation of accepted orders. This limit is outside selectable and strategy profiles.

maxContextBars.description: Max bars per timeframe cached in context (memory/perf trade-off)

avoidRoundShareQuantities.description: Avoid stock entry order sizes ending in 0 or 5 by subtracting two shares

maxDrawings.description: Maximum retained drawing lifetimes for each strategy and reference-symbol lane.

IOperationalTraderConfig.description: Server defaults select only published production strategies; frozen day inputs resolve their keys.

poolIds.description: Optional run-level pool ids selected from the global instrument pool catalog

symbols.description: Explicit symbols added on top of the selected pools

excludedSymbols.description: Symbols excluded globally from the resolved universe

id.description: Canonical generic profile id referenced by account default and allowed profile identifiers.

maxRiskPercPerTrade.description: Maximum loss budget per trade as a ratio of available capital, where 1 is 100%. Signal confidence and HV modifiers can only reduce this budget. The resulting position is separately capped by maxCapitalPerTrade.

maxDrawdownPercPerDay.description: Soft risk-day drawdown ratio, where 1 is 100%. It is measured from the tax-neutral performance-equity peak since the account risk-day boundary and blocks new entries without liquidating positions.

hv.description: Optional historical-volatility sizing rule. Its lookback extends strategy warmup, its bands scale the loss budget, and its shock estimates per-unit risk when the signal has no explicit stop distance.

minCapitalPerTrade.description: Minimum final capital allocation required to open a trade. Fixed values use account currency; percentage values use available capital at signal time. Orders below the resolved threshold are discarded. Example: 1_000 means skip trades that would allocate less than $1k.

maxCapitalPerTrade.description: Maximum capital allocated per trade after loss-budget sizing. Fixed values use account currency; percentage values resolve against available capital at signal time before conversion to shares/contracts.

maxSpreadPerTrade.description: Maximum spread accepted at the executable order price. Fixed values use price units and percentage values use the executable price; wider spreads discard the entry before order creation.

maxDailyVolumeParticipationPerTrade.description: Maximum share of the previous completed daily bar volume that a new order may request, where 1 is 100%. Missing usable daily volume discards the entry instead of assuming liquidity.

minRecentExecutionBars.description: Minimum number of recent completed one-minute execution bars with positive volume required before entry.

maxExecutionBarGapFactor.description: Maximum allowed gap between consecutive recent completed one-minute execution bars, expressed as a multiple of one minute.

minSignalScore.description: Minimum confidence × causal strategy rank required before an entry may be sized.

IConfigLiveRiskProfile.description: Entry-risk policy applicable to real broker execution.

threshold.description: Inclusive daily-HV upper bound for this band; null is the required final catch-all.

riskMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the per-trade loss budget when observed daily HV falls in this band. It may reduce the base budget but cannot increase it above the configured maximum.

bands.description: Ordered historical-volatility bands. The first threshold greater than or equal to the observed daily HV supplies its multiplier, and exactly one final null threshold is the required catch-all.

lookbackDays.description: Daily bars used to compute hvDaily for this profile. This sets the lookback window for volatility, not the sizing formula itself. Example: 10 for scalping, 20 for intraday, 30 for swing, 60 for position.

shock.description: Multiple of daily HV used to estimate a "shock" per unit when no explicit stop distance is provided by the strategy. perUnitRisk = hvDaily * hvShockMultiple * price. Example: 1.5 ≈ 1.5 sigma shock.

strategyProfileId.description: Canonical strategy-type id referenced by Strategy.RiskProfileId and used to find this optional override.

preferredRiskProfileId.description: Generic risk profile requested before this strategy risk override is applied. A present preference is selected instead of the account default before field-level overrides are applied.

maxRiskPercPerTrade.description: Optional replacement for the selected profile's maximum loss budget per trade, where 1 is 100% of available capital before signal-confidence and HV reductions.

maxDrawdownPercPerDay.description: Optional replacement for the selected profile's soft risk-day drawdown ratio. The effective value blocks new entries after breach and does not liquidate positions.

minCapitalPerTrade.description: Optional replacement for the minimum final allocation required to keep an entry order.

maxCapitalPerTrade.description: Optional replacement for the maximum allocation per entry after risk sizing. Percentage values use available capital.

maxSpreadPerTrade.description: Optional replacement for the maximum spread accepted at the executable order price.

maxDailyVolumeParticipationPerTrade.description: Optional replacement for the maximum share of the previous completed daily bar volume requested by one entry.

minRecentExecutionBars.description: Optional replacement for the minimum number of recent completed one-minute bars with positive volume required before entry.

maxExecutionBarGapFactor.description: Optional replacement for the maximum gap between recent completed one-minute bars, as a multiple of one minute.

minSignalScore.description: Optional replacement for the minimum confidence × causal strategy rank accepted before sizing.

IConfigLiveStrategyRiskOverride.description: Strategy entry-risk overrides applicable to real broker execution.

threshold.description: Inclusive daily-HV upper bound for this band; null is the required final catch-all.

riskMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the per-trade loss budget when observed daily HV falls in this band. It may reduce the base budget but cannot increase it above the configured maximum.

bands.description: Replacement ordered volatility bands; omission inherits the selected generic profile bands.

lookbackDays.description: Replacement daily-bar lookback; omission inherits the selected generic profile lookback.

shock.description: Replacement HV shock multiple; omission inherits the selected generic profile shock.

IConfigHVRuleOverride.description: Field-level historical-volatility values inside one strategy risk override.

strategyId.description: Exact strategy id from its catalog, including version (for example argo.quality-wide-target@v1).

tolerancePerc.description: Adverse tolerance as a ratio of raw target price; zero requires a close at or beyond target.

IConfigStrategyTargetExitOverride.description: Strategy-specific replacement for the common completed-minute target tolerance.

active.description: Whether to consider approaching (pre-trigger) signals in order creation

notify.description: Whether to send notifications for approaching signals

logLevel.description: Diagnostic detail written to the live journal log; standard still retains errors and signal outcomes.

useStrategyScores.description: Whether the live trader freezes and consumes causal strategy scores when it starts or restarts

channels.description: Channels where to send notifications - individual notifications can override this

messageWrapper.description:
Optional message wrapper

Supported placeholders:
- {body} - the notification message
- {<meta_key1>}, {<meta_key1>}, ... - the notification meta keys, if any

chatIds.description: A list of chats where to spread the notifications

IConfigServerBatchService.description: Server maintenance never owns full-history dates or raw archive destinations.

requests.description: Maximum number of requests allowed within the window

windowMs.description: Time window in milliseconds for the rate limit

minDelayMs.description: Minimum delay in milliseconds between requests

IConfigServerDataset.description: Configurable dataset admission and scope for operational maintenance.

symbols.description: Exact provider-owned stock symbols included in addition to configured pools.

instrumentPoolIds.description: Materialized point-in-time instrument pools included in this dataset.

IConfigMassiveFlatFileUniverse.description: Symbol scope applied before a Massive flat file becomes a local aggregate.
